heading: Friday, August 1, 2025
topLine: Google rolls out Gemini 2.5 Deep Think to Ultra subscribers.

items.headline: Google rolls out Gemini 2.5 Deep Think to Ultra subscribers
items.summary: Gemini 2.5 Deep Think uses parallel thinking and longer inference time. Google describes it as a faster variant of the model that reached gold-medal standard at the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad. It launched in the Gemini app for Google AI Ultra subscribers.

image.alt: Gemini 2.5 Deep Think reasoning, code and math scores compared with o3 and Grok 4
